title: Hernán Núñez (Stockholm) to Fuenmayor (Copenhagen), December 1674, DECODE R1012-R1015

steps.what: Parsed DECODE's DOC transcriptions into cipher tokens and margin text; normalised g.3 to que.
Aligner run per image, with no anchors.
Seven anchors from the repeated pair representado / representare; aligner per record.
Recognised the values as the Balbases 1677 key and applied it unchanged.
The key reproduces the margins of all four letters; 167, 161, os, 30, 6+, 4 were added from context.

The 118 groups dec.py left unread checked on the 16 DECODE images (two image agents): 62 DECODE misreadings (the looped 4 read as 9, g for y, split and merged groups), 48 code groups fixed by the margin (e.g. bof = guerra, cuf = Inglaterra, 187 = tiempo, C+ = ll), 7 nulls, 1 illegible; key corrections 13 = e and underlined N = V.S.; two lines DECODE omitted on R1012 found (fix_R1012.tsv, fix_R1013-15.tsv, dec2.py).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): DECODE transcriptions with the margins (tx/) and the second-pass decodes (read2/); key = the Balbases 1677 key plus the image-pass values in fix_R1012.tsv and fix_R1013-15.tsv

Verification 5 (plain-bar rows): R1012-R1015 had no reading, only the unspaced key decodes with the margin transcriptions (plain 0.06-0.33). Readings written from the contemporary margin decipherments checked against the decodes, read2/R101x_reading.md: plain 0.577/0.643/0.81/0.889, explicit 0.923/1.0/1.0/1.0. Keep read (R1012's plain shortfall is names, period spellings and words the es list lacks).

outcome.method_basis: The key rebuilt earlier in this project for Balbases 1677, from letters in the same Brussels volume (SEG inv. 2559), was recognised in an anchored alignment against the margins and applied unchanged; it reproduces the contemporary marginal decipherment on every passage, and 48 code groups and several values were added from those margins.
outcome.fraction_read_source: read2/R*.txt headers from dec2.py (cipher tokens of DECODE's transcription, image-pass values applied): 1,716 tokens, 1 unread (R1014, illegible); 11 image-pass values graded M, 0.993 excluding them. First pass (read/, dec.py) was 0.93 with 118 unknown. The two lines DECODE omitted on R1012 are not in the token count
outcome.notes: Margins verified and illegible margin words recovered from the key. Attack corrected 22 Sept 2026 from 'known plaintext': every passage carries its contemporary margin decipherment, and the Balbases 1677 key (targets/balbases1677/key.json) was applied unchanged.

texts.label: R1012, Hernán Núñez to Fuenmayor, Stockholm, 5 Dec 1674
texts.summary: The Spanish envoy in Sweden tells the Spanish envoy in Denmark that Sweden has agreed with Denmark on every point of the treaty project, but a clause not to oppose Sweden's coming armament would void the earlier articles, 'a game of words' typical of princes; the Swedish envoy at Copenhagen is 'hombre lleno de artificios'.

reading_review.note: v5 check 23 Oct 2026 (1674 Spanish: plain share is a bar too): the sweep scored read2/R1012.txt, the unspaced key decode with its margin transcription (plain 0.189, explicit 0.919): no reading had been written. Workable: the contemporary margin decipherment and the decode reconciled word by word into read2/R1012_reading.md (margin spelling, the decode giving the word where the margin transcription is garbled): plain 0.577 (15/26), explicit 0.923 (24/26); the misses are names (Suecia, Dinamarca), period spellings (añadiesse, ay, aya, aora, essa, creydo, deverle, escrive) and ordinary words the es list lacks (anulados, supone, artificios, parcial); two real holes (casi como [?] [?]; the cut end). Read as a reader the sentences hold. Keeps read.

texts.label: R1013, Hernán Núñez to Fuenmayor, 15 Dec 1674
texts.summary: Hamburg has refused to carry a Brandenburg gentleman on its ship so as not to offend Sweden, bought with Swedish promises and presents; Núñez hopes Hamburg, intimidated, will withdraw its confidence in the Swedes, which would encourage the Danes.

reading_review.note: v5 check 23 Oct 2026 (1674 Spanish: plain share is a bar too): the sweep scored read2/R1013.txt, the unspaced key decode with its margin transcription (plain 0.056, explicit 0.889): no reading had been written. Read as a reader the sentences hold. Keeps read.

texts.label: R1014, Hernán Núñez to Fuenmayor, 19 Dec 1674
texts.summary: Sweden's embassy to Copenhagen is meant to gain time against the French ambassador's demands for the aid due under the last treaty; talk of Charles XI's marriage to the Danish king's sister; keeping Denmark on side is the only way to hold Sweden back.

texts.label: R1015, Hernán Núñez to Fuenmayor, 26 Dec 1674
texts.summary: Before it rises the Swedish senate will decide whether to assist France 'a mano armada'; Núñez has broken off his baths to lobby. Sweden invaded Brandenburg that same month, which began the Scanian War.
